column1: # Random cells of IN with a ranges table, held out: the rules were worked out before these cells were run.
# Columns: type of a, value of a, type of low and high, the rows of the ranges table, expected result of "a IN table"
# (T or F, or DUMP:<runtime error>), expected sy-fdpos afterwards (- if the expression does not set it).
# The table has the components sign (c LENGTH 1), option (c LENGTH 2), low and high. A row is
# sign|option|low|high, rows are separated by ";", [] is the empty table; an empty low or high is the initial value
# Operands are set as in comparison.tsv: a c, n, d or t holds exactly the characters given, padded with blanks; any
# other type gets the given text converted to it (x and xstring as hex digits). The operands are data objects whose
# type is known at run time only (generic parameters).
# No cell has a CP or NP row whose pattern ends in a # that escapes nothing.
